verdict.rationale: cubic's AI wiki automatically indexes the codebase and produces searchable wikis with architecture diagrams and links to source, and codebase scans deploy AI agents across the whole repo, both without manual file selection, which supports mapping/explaining an unfamiliar codebase. However, cubic is fundamentally a PR-review/analytics tool and there's no evidence of an interactive 'explain this codebase' chat experience beyond PR-scoped chat context, and no independent/community validation of the wiki or codebase-scan quality for onboarding to unfamiliar code. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of the AI wiki's explanatory quality, evidence of open-ended codebase Q&A outside PR context, and community corroboration of codebase-mapping accuracy.
